description: SDK and CLI for MCP server authors: declare the server once with defineConnector() and ship a branded package that installs itself into 42 agent hosts (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Zed, Kiro, Warp, OpenCode, …) — native config, hooks, skills, Agent Plugins bundle, per-tool token telemetry.
rules: agent-connector is a dependency of the developer's own MCP package, not a globally installed tool: add @ken-jo/agent-connector to that package and expose install/doctor/uninstall through the package's own bin via createConnectorCli().
Declare the connector once with defineConnector({ server, hooks, skills, ... }) in agent-connector.config.mjs; never hand-write per-host config files — the CLI renders each host's native format.
package.json name/mcpName/bin/version are the default identity source; explicit id/displayName/bin/version in defineConnector are advanced overrides.
The connector-free `agent-connector usage` command is for people who only USE agent hosts and want whole-conversation token totals; it is not part of the MCP-author flow.
For the full per-host reference (paths, root keys, hook events, surfaces) read llms-full.txt; llms.txt is the short route map.
